## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`select_failures` needs to normalize paths before comparing them, because report entries spelled with a `./` prefix currently never match and those failed tests are not selected.

## Changes
This pull request adds `select_failures`, which picks failed paths from a runner report that are also in the requested set. It also rewrites `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` without changing their behavior, and adds `tests/test_selection.py` with one test for each selector.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before the membership check — When a report lists `"./tests/test_x.py"` and `requested` is `{"tests/test_x.py"}`, `select_failures` returns `[]` because it compares the raw path. `select_explicit` at `app/selection.py:6` handles the same input by testing `normalize(path) in requested` and still returns the original spelling, which is what the docstring promises. The added test at `tests/test_selection.py:43` uses only paths without the prefix, so it does not catch this. — Failed tests that the runner reports with a `./` prefix are silently left out of re-runs. — Fix: Use `[path for path in report["failed"] if normalize(path) in requested]` and add a `./`-prefixed case to `test_failure_report_selection`.
